title: 第533章 红太狼和懒羊羊隐藏的事
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始

第(1/3)页

说完这句话，林远将四只羊放入了紫色大锅中。

他是将沸羊羊与美羊羊面对面放的，但是并没有让二者贴在一起。

而是将四只羊放到了东南西北四个锅边。

喜羊羊在最北边，懒羊羊在最南边，沸羊羊在最西边，美羊羊在最东边。

和沸羊羊的约定是正面绑着，又没说要贴着。

放入锅中不久后，四只羊就在沸腾的水中清醒了过来。

而此时，狼堡的一楼安静无比。

林远特意在喜羊羊、美羊羊、懒羊羊的绳索上打了死结，给沸羊羊只是象征性的绑了绑。

“啊！喜羊羊，我们现在该怎么办？”

美羊羊醒来的第一件事，是喊喜羊羊。

虽然她率先看到的是沸羊羊，但还是向旁边的喜羊羊问道。

喜羊羊试着挣脱身上的绳索，可惜却是白费力气。

实在是......太紧了。

“都怪你喜羊羊，来救我们太晚了。”

“要是早一点的话，灰太狼就不会抓住我们四个了。”

懒羊羊打了个哈欠，感觉浑身酸疼。

“还有你沸羊羊，居然被灰太狼一下子扔了过来，我真是服了你。”

“你不会自己在空中改变一下方向吗？”

懒羊羊的语气说出这种话，给人一种大义凛然的感觉。

沸羊羊已经感受到身上的绳索非常松动，而且灰太狼解除了他身上的定身效果。

他明白......灰太狼给了他英雄救美的机会。

不过太快挣脱束缚的话有些假，他要好好演一演。

“懒羊羊，你这么厉害能在空中改变方向？”

“你不知道曾有位科学家发现了万有引力定律吗？”

“叫什么牛......”

沸羊羊原本想展现一波自己的知识，却在关键时候卡了壳。

“牛顿先生。”

喜羊羊脱口而出。

美羊羊一脸崇拜地看向喜羊羊，眼神中满是仰慕：

“不愧是喜羊羊，居然一下就说出了关键。”

“那喜羊羊，你快想想我们应该怎么逃走吧？”

听到这话，沸羊羊的脸瞬间黑了下去。

好你个喜羊羊，又抢我的风头。

喜羊羊没有在意美羊羊的赞美，整理了一下思绪，陷入了短暂的沉默。

看到喜羊羊都这样，美羊羊哭哭啼啼起来。

“哎呀，连喜羊羊都没有办法，这下可真是完了。”

“不过你们说，这次的灰太狼是真的吗？”

“还是说和之前一样，都是假的？”

“呜呜呜，要是假的就完蛋了，我们都得死。”

懒羊羊听到美羊羊的话，眼底闪过了一抹精光。

“美羊羊，什么假的灰太狼啊，我怎么听不懂？”

“是不是我最近睡糊涂了啊？”

懒羊羊收敛起了眼底的光，转移话题道。

美羊羊扭过头，收起了哭哭啼啼的表情：

“懒羊羊，你一天出来就知道睡觉。”

“你不知道，之前已经出现过了很多灰太狼吗？”

“不过也是，每次都是我和喜羊羊解决的，你就知道睡觉的。”

懒羊羊的表情微变。

出现了很多灰太狼？

莫非这次，他和红太狼成功了？

沸羊羊不愧是羊村里美羊羊的第一舔羊，当即选择站在了美羊羊一方。

“是啊，懒羊羊。”

“你一天天的也太懒啦，连慢羊羊讲过的这些都忘记了。”

话刚说完，沸羊羊就连连道歉：

“不是你哭啥啊，懒羊羊？”

“我不说你了，你别哭啊，我回头给你吃我存下的草，行不行？”

沸羊羊也没想到，自己只是帮美羊羊说了几句，懒羊羊竟然哭了。

人家美羊羊对着喜羊羊哭哭啼啼他能理解，怎么他沸羊羊对着懒羊羊说了两句，就哭上了？

你哭就哭，问题是美羊羊在这里，你这不是让他在美羊羊心中大打折扣吗？

原本知识层面就输给了喜羊羊，你不能让羊品也输给喜羊羊吧？

懒羊羊点了点头，鼻涕顺势流入了汤汁中。

“我不哭了，我就是突然好感动啊。”

“终于......回来啦。”

沸羊羊没有在意懒羊羊说的终于回来了是什么意思。

因为他的心碎了。

混合了懒羊羊鼻涕的汤汁，他还怎么保留？

毁灭吧，这汤汁谁爱要谁要！

美羊羊摇了摇头：

“果然这就是一天吃了睡，睡了吃的代价。”

“懒羊羊已经分不清现实和梦境了。”

美羊羊认为，懒羊羊这样说是因为好吃懒做，所付出的代价。

唯独喜羊羊，向懒羊羊投来了一抹深邃的幽光。

他不清楚懒羊羊这么说是为何，但他总有一种感觉......面前的懒羊羊，变了。

他接触过之前的懒羊羊，一些微小的细节，他很容易察觉。

“干嘛这么看我，喜羊羊。”

“你就算这么看我，我也不给你吃我的鼻涕。”

After saying this, Lin Yuan put the four sheep into the purple cauldron.

He put the Boiling Sheep and the Beautiful Sheep face to face, but did not let them stick together.

Instead, the four sheep were placed beside the four pots in the southeast, northwest and northwest.

The Pleasant Goat is in the far north, the Lazy Goat is in the south, the Boiling Goat is in the west, and the Beautiful Goat is in the east.

The agreement with Feiyangyang was to tie it from the front, but it didn't say that it would be attached.

Shortly after being put into the pot, the four sheep woke up in the boiling water.

At this time, the first floor of Wolfsburg was extremely quiet.

Lin Yuan specially tied knots on the ropes of Pleasant Goat, Beautiful Goat, and Lazy Goat, but only tied them symbolically for Boiling Goat.

"Ah! Pleasant Goat, what should we do now?"

The first thing that the beautiful sheep did when she woke up was to call Pleasant Goat.

Although the first thing she saw was the Boiling Goat, she still asked the Pleasant Goat next to her.

Pleasant Goat tried to break free from the rope, but it was in vain.

It's just...too tight.

"It's all your fault, Pleasant Goat, it was too late to save us."

"If it had been earlier, Big Big Wolf wouldn't have caught the four of us."

Lazy Yangyang yawned and felt sore all over.

"And you, Feiyangyang, were actually thrown over by Big Big Wolf all at once. I'm really impressed by you."

"Won't you change the direction yourself in the air?"

Lazy Yangyang said this in a tone that gave people a sense of righteousness.

Boiling Yangyang has already felt that the rope on his body is very loose, and Big Big Wolf has lifted the immobilizing effect on him.

He understands... Big Big Wolf gave him the chance to be a hero and save the beauty.

But breaking free from the restraints too quickly would be a bit false, he wanted to put on a good show.

"Lazy Yangyang, are you so powerful that you can change direction in the air?"

"Didn't you know that there was a scientist who discovered the law of gravity?"

"What kind of cow is called..."

Boiling Yangyang originally wanted to show off his knowledge, but got stuck at the critical moment.

"Mr. Newton."

Pleasant Goat blurted out.

Beautiful Goat looked at Pleasant Goat with admiration, her eyes full of admiration:

"As expected of Pleasant Goat, he actually told the key point right away."

"Then Pleasant Goat, please think about how we should escape?"

Hearing this, Feiyangyang's face turned dark instantly.

You Pleasant Goat, you stole my limelight again.

Pleasant Goat didn't pay attention to Beautiful Goat's praise, sorted out his thoughts, and fell into a brief silence.

Seeing Pleasant Goat like this, Beautiful Goat started crying.

"Oh, even Pleasant Goat can't do anything about it. It's really over now."

"But do you think the Big Big Wolf this time is real?"

"Or is it just like before, it's all fake?"

"Uuuuuuuuuah, if it's fake, it's over, we will all die."

When Lazy Yangyang heard Meiyangyang's words, a flash of light flashed in his eyes.

"Beautiful Yangyang, what fake Big Big Wolf? Why can't I understand?"

"Am I too sleepy recently?"

Lazy Yangyang restrained the light in his eyes and changed the subject.

Meiyangyang turned her head and put away her crying expression:

"Lazy Yangyang, you know how to sleep as soon as you come out."

"Don't you know that there have been many gray wolves before?"

"But yes, Pleasant Goat and I solve it every time, so you know how to sleep."

Lazy Sheep's expression changed slightly.

A lot of gray wolves appeared?

Could it be that this time, he and Red Wolf succeeded?

Feiyangyang was worthy of being the number one licker of Meiyangyang in Yangcun, and he immediately chose to side with Meiyangyang.

"Yes, lazy sheep."

"You are so lazy every day that you have even forgotten what Man Yangyang said."

As soon as he finished speaking, Feiyangyang apologized again and again:

"Why are you crying, lazy sheep?"

"I won't talk about you anymore. Don't cry. I'll feed you the grass I saved later, okay?"

Boiling Yangyang didn't expect that Lazy Yangyang would actually cry when he just said a few words to Mei Yangyang.

He could understand the beautiful sheep crying at the happy sheep, but why did the angry sheep start crying after saying a few words to the lazy sheep?

Cry as long as you want. The problem is that Meiyangyang is here. Aren't you making him lose heart in Meiyangyang?

Originally, we lost to Pleasant Goat in terms of knowledge. You can't let Yangpin lose to Pleasant Goat, right?

Lazy Sheep nodded, and the mucus flowed into the soup.

"I stopped crying. I was suddenly so moved."

"Finally...back."

Boiling Yangyang didn't care what Lazy Yangyang meant when he said he was finally back.

Because his heart was broken.

How could he keep the soup mixed with lazy sheep's snot?

Destroy it, whoever loves this soup wants it!

Meiyangyang shook her head:

"Sure enough, this is the price of eating and sleeping for a day, and eating after sleeping."

"Lazy Sheep can no longer distinguish between reality and dreams."

Meiyangyang believes that Lazyyangyang says this because it is delicious and lazy, and it is the price paid for it.

Only the Pleasant Goat cast a deep light on the Lazy Goat.

He didn't know why Lazy Yangyang said this, but he always had a feeling... Lazy Yangyang in front of him had changed.

He had come into contact with Lazy Sheep before, and he could easily detect some tiny details.

"Why are you looking at me like that, Pleasant Goat."

"Even if you look at me like this, I won't let you eat my snot."
